source: Mapzen Terrain Tiles, AWS Open Data: https://registry.opendata.aws/terrain-tiles/
attribution: Mapzen / Tilezen terrain tiles. Global SRTM and GMTED2010 terrain data courtesy of the U.S. Geological Survey. Global ETOPO1 terrain data: DOC/NOAA/NESDIS/NCEI, U.S. Department of Commerce. U.S. Government terrain material is not subject to copyright protection within the United States.
layout: row-major; rows south-to-north, columns west-to-east; bounds endpoints included
sampling: Bilinear resampling of decoded Terrarium RGB elevations; rounded to 0.01 m. No procedural elevation or smoothing.
